title: Transformation Cost

story.briefing: The stored instruction has drifted from the original. Each repair — inserting a character, deleting one, or replacing one — costs the Core a cycle. Find the cheapest correction.
story.success: Instruction corrected at minimum cost. The drift is undone.

description: Given two strings, return the fewest single-character operations needed to turn the first into the second. The permitted operations are inserting a character, deleting a character, and replacing a character, each costing 1.
hints: When the current characters match, no operation is needed there. When they differ, three repairs are possible, and you take whichever leads to the cheapest total.
The edges of the table are not zero here. Turning a string of length i into an empty one costs i deletions, and those base cases carry the whole calculation.

Fill a table indexed by positions in both strings, with the first row and column counting up from 0. On a match, copy the diagonal; otherwise take one plus the smallest of the diagonal, the left, and the above entries.
